name: Villager
description: No special ability. Use your voice and your vote.

name: Werewolf
description: Wake with the other werewolves and learn who they are. If you're the only werewolf, you may look at one center card.

name: Minion
description: Learn who the werewolves are (they don't know you). Win with the werewolves even if you're voted out.

name: Mason
description: Wake and see the other Mason, if there is one.

name: Seer
description: Look at another player's card, or two of the three center cards.

name: Robber
description: You may swap your card with another player's card, then look at your new card.

name: Troublemaker
description: You may swap cards between two other players, without looking at them.

name: Drunk
description: Swap your card with one from the center, without looking at either.

name: Insomniac
description: At the end of the night, look at your own card to see if it changed.

name: Tanner
description: You want to die. If you're voted out, you win alone and everyone else loses.

name: Hunter
description: If you're voted out, whoever you voted for dies too.
